title: Pure Impcantation
summary: Impcantation cards only, with generic staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Rather than serving solely as a Ritual engine for another archetype, this pure build focuses on Impcantation's own Ritual Monsters: Impcantation Chalislime and Crealtar, the Impcantation Originator.

summary.title: Starters
points: Impcantation Candoll and Impcantation Bookstone each reveal a Ritual Spell in your hand to Special Summon themselves and another Impcantation from the Deck; when Special Summoned from the Deck, Candoll searches a Ritual Spell and Bookstone recovers one from the GY.

Impcantation Talismandra and Impcantation Penciplume each reveal a Ritual Monster in your hand to Special Summon themselves and another Impcantation from the Deck; when Special Summoned from the Deck, Talismandra searches a Ritual Monster and Penciplume recovers one from the GY.
Impcantation Chalislime reveals itself in the hand and discards 1 card to Special Summon any Impcantation monster from the Deck, triggering that monster's search or recovery effect.

summary.title: Opening: Impcantation Chalislime + Any Card
steps: Reveal Impcantation Chalislime in your hand and discard 1 card to Special Summon Impcantation Candoll from the Deck; Candoll searches Impcantation Inception.

Reveal Impcantation Inception in your hand to Special Summon Impcantation Bookstone (or Talismandra) from your hand and a second Impcantation from the Deck, adding Crealtar, the Impcantation Originator.

Activate Impcantation Inception to Tribute the non-Ritual Impcantations on your field for Crealtar, the Impcantation Originator, then send another Impcantation from your hand or field to the GY to return Inception to your hand and summon another Impcantation from the Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Crealtar, the Impcantation Originator (3000 ATK) discards 1 card during either Main Phase as a Quick Effect to Special Summon non-Ritual Impcantation monsters from your GY whose total Levels equal 10, while granting all non-Ritual Impcantations +2000 ATK and negating their activated effects on the field.
Impcantation Chalislime sends 1 Impcantation monster from your hand or field to the GY to target and destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.
While Candoll, Talismandra, Bookstone, or Penciplume is face-up in the Monster Zone, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck—tributing them for Impcantation Inception clears the lock.

summary.title: Spells
points: Impcantation Inception Ritual Summons any Ritual Monster by Tributing only Impcantation monsters from your hand or field, and from the GY sends an Impcantation from your hand or field to the GY to return itself to the hand and Special Summon an Impcantation from the Deck.

Impcantation Thanatosis reveals an Impcantation monster in your hand to Special Summon 2 copies with that name from the Deck and shuffle the revealed card back, and destroys 1 card on the field whenever a Ritual Monster is Special Summoned.
